prerequisites.instruction: Confirm the selected Google account and Developer Preview membership. The preview program terms prohibit public applications using preview features before general availability.

Select a Google Cloud project; enable gmail.googleapis.com and gmailmcp.googleapis.com. Configure consent, audience/test users and host-appropriate OAuth client credentials with the actual host redirect URI, not a copied example redirect.

The guide lists gmail.readonly and gmail.compose scopes. The credential owner must verify the selected account, consent and required scopes, retain secrets and handle refresh/revoke; this bundle contains no credentials.
Confirm the project service-enablement permissions and any Workspace administrator restrictions on the selected OAuth app and scopes.

Meet Google's documented prompt/response screening requirement using Model Armor or the host's documented alternative accepted by users. Do not enable a service, grant permissions or transmit content to another processor implicitly.

Bind the concrete connection, current schema, operation limits, policy and lifecycle in an ActivationManifest. Require owner-authenticated account and role readiness receipts before usable tools are reported.

Select and verify repository source or a retained local wheel/npm tarball as described in SUPPORT.md. Python requires 3.11+ and HTTPX 0.28.x; TypeScript uses the documented Node 22+ Fetch profile. Neither artifact is claimed to be publicly released.

Enable Gmail API in the selected project; configure consent/audience, any required verification and a suitable OAuth client for the actual host. The quickstart is setup guidance, not the production credential owner.
Select the mailbox and a corresponding authorized credential. The explicit account path, including me, does not itself establish credential ownership or delegated access.

The host supplies the authenticated client with the selected API base, account and minimal operation scopes. Read/query and send permissions differ; gmail.metadata cannot authorize a query. No ambient credential lookup, scope expansion or authentication replay is supplied.
Resolve applicable organization app/access restrictions for that mailbox and requested scopes before use.

The host composes the operation library into the existing service export and enforces requester/resource policy, approval of complete MIME and recipients, bounded paging, cancellation, revoke and uncertain-write reconciliation. Keep secrets outside model context.

blockers: A host adapter must bind the selected local SDK artifact, account, operations, schemas and lifecycle to the existing service-connector export. The operation libraries are not an activated agent tool surface.
The host must supply its own authenticated client, OAuth registration and credential lifecycle, scoped authorization and any send approval/reconciliation. This recipe supplies none of those owners.
Only repository source and recorded local build artifacts are available here; no public PyPI/npm release or live Gmail conformance is established.
